summary: One church (St. Bede, Holland). Two image-only issues (Nov 8, Nov 15) print the same schedule box: Sat 5:30 PM vigil, Sun 7:30/9:30/11:00/12:30, Mon-Fri 6:30 and 9:00, Sat 8:30, Saturday confession 4-5 PM; the website matches. Dated: Dec 2 7 PM Advent Mass, Dec 16 7 PM Advent Confession. Open: whether the perpetual Adoration chapel ('adjacent to the Drexel Center') is on the grounds (lean include as 24h, code 9 PM-7 AM), and Dec 7/8 holy-day Masses from the undated standing line (lean leave out).

slots.rationale: R32/R38, leaning per precedent ss-philip-and-james-exton s15 (and sacred-heart-havertown s13, st-pius-x-broomall s25): the parish's own schedule box lists the chapel, the website places it 'adjacent to the Drexel Center', a parish building that hosts parish meetings, and the parish has one church. If on the grounds, R46 makes it one 24h slot: a door combination is needed 9 PM-7 AM only, so code-after-hours with open 07:00-21:00 (the st-mary-schwenksville s17 case had no code printed; this one does). The website says the tabernacle is an Exposition Tabernacle. Hard because no page gives the chapel's or the Drexel Center's address.
